result.title: Blendshape Generation for Models with Disconnected Parts: Adding ARKit/MediaPipe Blendshapes to Anime-Style Character Models
result.summary: Blendshape generation for 3D models has been extensively researched, but very few works address generating blendshapes for models with multiple disconnected parts. We present a case study of generating fixed facial expression blendshapes for commercial anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 parts per face. To make sure that our system can handle models in a way that is agnostic to topology, we train neural networks to generate deformation fields around the input meshes. We employ at least one network to independently process each part, and the relative positions of their outputs are coordinated by having each network also process the geometry of an anchor part. We use two mechanisms to improve accuracy: having the networks predict whether the output displacement is zero or not, and classifying blendshapes into different size groups and dedicating a network to each group. We also introduce a method to improve blendshape quality by enhancing bilateral symmetry. Our method is simpler than recent neural-network-based works and solves a real problem of the user community of these models.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作面向由多个不连通部件构成的动漫风格 3D 角色模型，用神经网络生成变形场来输出 ARKit/MediaPipe 表情 blendshape，并通过锚点部件协调、位移是否为零的预测、尺寸分组及双侧对称增强来提高精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 3D 人脸表情生成与几何变形建模，未涉及多模态推理中的内部表示、证据筛选或推理状态更新，也未提供可迁移到 LVR 的具体状态或决策线索。
